environment_status: owner-confirmed test/development application; deployed commit SHA not exposed or independently verified
decision: A fresh safe GET to /dashboard redirected to /login and the DOM exposed the login form. The browser session available to this audit is not authenticated. Representative-role task execution, viewport journey execution and any new signed-in visual claims remain blocked until the owner exposes a signed-in test/development tab to the browser-control session.
minimum_input: Open and sign in to the test/development application in a Chrome tab connected to Codex, leave that tab open, and confirm it is ready. Do not provide the password, MFA code, token or other secret in the chat.
